evidence_snippets: “DTaP-IPV-HB-PRP-T or hexavalent vaccines are indicated for primary and booster vaccination of infants and toddlers against diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, hepatitis B, poliomyelitis and invasive diseases caused by Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib).”

“Each dose (0.5 mL) of MenC vaccine (NeisVac-C®, Baxter A.G.; batch number: VNSM04C) contained: 10 μg Neisseria meningitidis serogroup C polysaccharide conjugated to 10--20 μg tetanus toxoid; and 0.5 mg aluminium hydroxide…”

“Since the introduction of meningococcal serogroup C conjugate (MenC) vaccines in the national immunisation programmes for infants and toddlers, there has been a substantial decline in invasive meningococcal disease (IMD) caused by serogroup C.”
key_data_points: Hexavalent DTaP-IPV-HB-PRP-T targets: diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, hepatitis B, poliomyelitis (types 1, 2, 3), and Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib).
Co-administered meningococcal vaccine is serogroup-specific: Neisseria meningitidis serogroup C (MenC).
study_population: Healthy full-term infants in Finland aged 46–74 days at enrollment (randomized n=350).
